headline: ExxonMobil Starts Production at Uaru Field Offshore Guyana
summary: ExxonMobil Guyana commenced oil production at the Uaru development within the offshore Stabroek block. The launch marks the country's fifth producing offshore deepwater crude project.
why: Guyana's Stabroek block, operated by ExxonMobil, has become one of the world's fastest-growing deepwater oil provinces, significantly boosting global non-OPEC crude supplies.

impacts.name: Exxon Mobil
impacts.why: Starting production at the fifth offshore Guyana project increases the company's daily crude output and cash flow.
